## 维护者速读

- 问题：开启环境隔离的部署（目前只有云端）会在一个匿名地址上公开说“允许写代码、允许所有流程节点”，但云端实际并不允许；今天没有任何工具读这个地址，第一个信它的客户端会写出被拒的应用。
- 选项：A 新增一个“宿主登记自己的限制档”的平台接口，两个地址都答宿主的真实限制，约 1 个平台 PR 加云端跟改；C 撤掉这个没人读的环境级地址（访问即 404），主地址不变，一个小 PR；D 维持现状，关卡。
- 推荐 C：这个地址没有读者，最省的长久做法是不公开它，而不是为它新建接口；将来真有按环境读限制档的客户端再做 A。
- 不定会怎样：云端继续匿名公开一条与实际不符的限制信息，第一个信它的客户端会踩坑。

Release: claim 7074584121 released into the decision inbox (`needs-user-decision`); the dev stopped before code as ordered — report 7074624585 (`needs_decision`, premise holds). Resume-from: `claude/issue-36198-scoped-restriction-profile-twin@4ab12189` (empty branch, no commits).

## Analysis (seat)

**Background.** The dev measured at `origin/main` 4ab12189: `packages/rest/src/discovery-routes.ts` L461-486 serves `openRestrictionProfile(spec)` with no host input; `rest-server.ts` (L5148-5157) mounts the same registrar on `{basePath}/environments/:environmentId` when `api.enableProjectScoping` is on (default `false`, `packages/spec/src/api/rest-server.zod.ts:175`), so only scoped hosts (cloud) mount the twin. No registered-profile seam exists (grep `restriction.?profile` over rest, runtime, core, types, spec contracts, services, plugins: only the route and the ledger). The only reader, `os validate --target` (`packages/cli/src/utils/restriction-profile.ts` L139/L224), reads the unscoped route only.

**Governing text.** ADR-0138 D2 amendment (2026-11-20), `docs/adr/0138-*.md` L359-361, re-read by this seat at `origin/main`: "`GET {basePath}/discovery/restriction-profile`, and its environment-scoped twin `GET {basePath}/environments/:environmentId/discovery/restriction-profile` where environment scoping mounts it. What it serves: a constant open profile, a `RestrictionProfileSchema` value that restricts nothing". Every fix other than D edits that sentence (governed `docs/adr/**`, Tier H).

**Protocol.** A adds a spec contract + service name (`Clause-②: yes`, widening). C removes an anonymous route that has no reader (`Clause-②: no`, narrowing; owes one contract-review-tier review before the queue). D changes nothing.

**Premises (re-check).**
- The twin answers the constant: `grep -n "openRestrictionProfile(spec)" packages/rest/src/discovery-routes.ts` → one hit inside the shared handler.
- No reader of the twin: `grep -rn "discovery/restriction-profile" packages --include=*.ts | grep -v test` → only the route, the CLI's unscoped constant and the ledger.
- No seam: `grep -rniE "restriction.?profile" packages/{runtime,core,types}/src packages/spec/src/contracts` → 0 hits.

**Options.**

| Option | What it does · what the customer sees | Effort (measured / precedent) |
|---|---|---|
| A — host-registered profile seam | Spec contract (environment-aware restriction-profile service) read by the one handler both mounts share; constant only when none is registered. Both anonymous answers become what the host enforces. | server+spec · 1 PR ~150-250 lines + ADR note (Tier H) + cloud moves its plugin onto the service (carrier: cloud). No precedent PR. |
| B — twin mirrors the unscoped mount | Measured not cleanly achievable: `resolveMountedRoute` returns a pattern only; needs `getRawApp` or a loopback call (a workaround), or a 307 that has no target under `projectResolution: required`. | Not recommended; a workaround. |
| C — unmount the twin | Register the restriction-profile route on the unscoped base only (the registrar already distinguishes the scoped base, as `/discovery` does); the twin answers the ordinary 404. Unscoped route unchanged; cloud's door still wins there by mount order. | server · 1 PR ~10 lines + pin + ADR note clause dropped (Tier H); cloud drops its ledger row (carrier: cloud). |
| D — status quo, close as designed | The false anonymous fact stays public on cloud. | none |

Business reading: A gives a per-environment answer nobody asks for today; C means the scoped path simply does not exist, which loses nothing (on a `required` host the CLI already cannot reach a profile); D leaves a wrong 200 an AI client could trust.

```text
os-decision-facets
① Long-term: C shrinks the anonymous surface to what is read (one route, one owner); A is the right end shape only once a scoped reader exists; D keeps a known false fact.
② Business pull: zero measured readers of the twin; cloud is the one producer of a narrower profile and already serves it on the unscoped path.
③ AI-error: C turns a wrong 200 into a loud 404; A makes it truthful; D is the quiet lie an AI client would trust.
④ Startup focus: C removes surface; A adds a permanent contract with zero pull; D is zero work but keeps the defect.
Prior rulings read: restriction-profile, ADR-0138 D2 → 1 hit (ADR-0138 D2 amendment 2026-11-20); thread: 0
```

**Recommendation: C.** Two years out the platform answers a profile per environment only if a client reads one; until then the sustainable shape is to publish nothing nobody reads (the end-state reading leads). Self-check: only ① gives C; ②③④ flip it? No. A is not taken: zero pull for a new contract. B is not taken: a router workaround. D is not taken: it leaves the declared-not-enforced answer public. Confidence gap: the dev did not probe a live cloud kernel; the hosted reading is cloud#4920 comment 7070292704.

**After the ruling.** C: this seat re-dispatches on the same branch (route + pin + ADR-0138 D2 note clause, Tier H → os-zhuang approval) and knocks the cloud seat for its ledger row. A: spec-lane contract first, then the handler, then cloud. D: the seat closes the card `not_planned` citing the ruling.

Ruling: **C — unmount the environment-scoped twin.** Maintainer Steve (account `os-steve`), verbatim 「C」, in this seat's project thread at 2026-11-22T10:10Z, answering the decision analysis 7074640338 (options A / B / C / D, seat recommendation C). The seat transcribes it here; it is the ruling's carrier.

- **Freshness gate:** re-read at 2026-11-22T10:11Z: the card body was last edited before 7074640338 (no edit event since), and no comment after 7074640338. The ruling answers the current text.
- **State transition (this stroke):** `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; the seat claims it in its next comment with `Ruling-ref:` this comment.
- **Blocked-by liveness:** none declared.
- **Conditions judged:** premises re-run at `origin/main` now: `openRestrictionProfile(spec)` is still the one answer in the shared handler (`packages/rest/src/discovery-routes.ts:476`), and the scoped base is still `${basePath}/environments/:environmentId` (`packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts:5140`). Both hold; the branch `claude/issue-36198-scoped-restriction-profile-twin` is still at 4ab12189 (no commits).

What C binds (from the analysis's row C, re-checked above): register the restriction-profile route on the unscoped base only, so the scoped twin answers the ordinary 404; the unscoped route is unchanged; a pin test for both; ADR-0138 D2 amendment's twin clause (`docs/adr/0138-*.md` L359-361) dropped in the same PR (Tier H → GOVERNED_APPROVERS). Cloud's ledger row for the twin is cloud's to drop (`carrier: cloud`); this seat notifies the cloud lane.

Governing text: ADR-0138 D2 amendment (2026-11-20).
